name: Seated One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
how_to:
1. Set Up the Position
  - Sit on a sturdy bench with back support to ensure proper posture.
  - Hold a dumbbell in one hand with a neutral grip (palm facing in).
  - Extend your arm overhead, keeping your elbow close to your head.
2. Starting Position
  - Your upper arm should remain perpendicular to the ground.
  - Keep your core engaged and spine neutral for stability.
3. Execution
  - Slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow.
  - Keep your elbow stationary while allowing the dumbbell to descend as far as your mobility allows.
  - Pause briefly at the bottom, then press the dumbbell back to the starting position by extending your elbow.
4. Repetitions and Sets
  - Perform 3 to 4 sets of 10 to 15 repetitions per arm.
